sentences.text: (BY SHRI C. S. PARMAR - GOVERNMENT ADVOCATE)

This application coming on for admission this day, the  following:
 ORDER
The applicant has filed this first application u/S.439 of Cr.P.C. for grant of bail.

The applicant has been arrested on 02/05/2024 by Police Station Kotwali, District Dindori (M.P.) in connection with Crime No.130/2024 registered for the offence punishable under Sections 420, 467,
468, 471 of IPC.
As per prosecution case, the applicant was posted as Supervisor in the Health Department and she was superannuated in the month of December, 2023.

Thereafter, she filed a W.P. No.30774/2023 before this Court for 2 MCRC-23050-2024 extension of her retirement period till 31/12/2026 on the basis of her mark-sheet of Class-XI in which the date of birth of applicant is mentioned as 05/12/1964.

This Court vide order dated 20/12/2023 dismissed the writ petition and finding a Smt. Anita Shukla vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 11 June, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/94019950/
1 suspicion of manipulation in the date of birth in the aforesaid mark-sheet, directed the Superintendent of Police, Dindori to conduct an enquiry in that regard.

sentences.text: In furtherance whereof an enquiry was conducted, in which it was found that the applicant has manipulated her date of birth from 05/12/1961 to 05/12/1964.
On the basis of aforesaid, present crime has been registered against the applicant.
Learned counsel for the applicant argued that applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated.
The applicant has no criminal history.
The applicant is a lady and she is permanent resident of District Dindori (M.P.), therefore, there is no likelihood of her absconsion or tempering with the prosecution evidence, if released on bail.
The applicant is in custody since 02/05/2024.
She is ready to abide by the terms and conditions as may be imposed.
Hence, he prays for grant of bail to the applicant.
P er contra, learned counsel for the State opposed the bail application and prayed for its rejection.
Heard learned counsel for the rival parties and perused the case diary available on record.

Considering the overall facts and circumstances of the case coupled with the fact that the trial is not likely to conclude in near future, but without expressing any opinion on merits of the case, this application is allowed and it is directed that the applicant be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.1,00,000/- (Rupees One Lac Only) with one solvent surety 3 MCRC-23050-2024 in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court.
In case, if she is found involving in any offence, this bail order shall stand cancelled automatically without further reference to the Bench.

5) The applicant will not seek unnecessary adjournments during the trial;
6) The applicant will not leave India without prior permission of the trial Court/Investigating Officer, as the case may be.
Certified copy as per rules.
